def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The background is a repeating color cycle, with row 0 offset from the
    # common background on the remaining rows. Keep the diagonal marks intact.
    first = grid[0][0]
    later = next((row[0] for row in grid[1:] if row[0] != 0), first)
    def cyc(start, c):
        return (start - 1 + c) % 9 + 1
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        start = first if r == 0 else later
        out.append([v if v else cyc(start, c) for c, v in enumerate(row)])
    return out
